The only agent framework with compile‑time sandboxing

Every action is executed by a LLM generated program which is type checked and compiled against granted capabilities before it runs.

Build your first agent View on GitHub ↗

What you get

A framework, three template agents, and no hidden runtime.

Fine grained capabilities

Define custom application level capabilities. Authority is type checked by the compiler

No credential leak risk

Agent action runtime is sandboxed without amibent resource access privilege.

Extra defense in depth

Easily add external OS sandbox resource limits to confine action runtime process.

Bring any model

Anthropic or OpenAI, provider-agnostic behind one Model interface. Swap with an env variable.

Skills & memory

Read-only reference the agent consults on demand, plus a durable scratchpad it curates itself.

Just a Jo project

Run it with jo run. No bespoke runtime, no framework magic — the toolchain you already have.

See it compile

Authorities enforced by the type checker.

Grant agent capabilities. LLM writes Jo program to execute actions. Compiler type checks the authority is granted, otherwise it's rejected

flight-agent · turn jo build
